columns.name: UNIQUE_ID
columns.description: Unique key of the client-to-policy cross-reference record. One value per record, never re-used.

columns.name: POLREF
columns.description: Reference of the policy the client is attached to.

columns.name: CLIREF
columns.description: Reference of the client (person, organisation, adviser or branch) attached to the policy.

columns.name: ROLREF
columns.description: Code for the role the client holds on the policy.

columns.name: CLICAT
columns.description: Category of the client record. Not captured for some beneficiaries.

columns.name: STAXRF
columns.description: Status of the client-to-policy cross-reference record.

columns.name: JTLIND
columns.description: For policyholder or life assured roles: 0 single life, 1 first life, 2 second life on a joint-life policy. For multi-client roles (e.g. beneficiary) it numbers each client in the role.

columns.name: SCHSUBCAT
columns.description: Sub-category within the employer scheme the policy belongs to. Set only on employer (EM) records; 0 otherwise.

columns.name: CONDITION_ITR
columns.description: Technical key used by the legacy file handler. Carries no information beyond UNIQUE_ID; 0 on pending records.

columns.name: CONDITION_SUB
columns.description: Technical key used by the legacy file handler. Carries no information beyond UNIQUE_ID.

columns.name: SURABR
columns.description: Abbreviated surname of the first life, used to list policies in surname order. Keyed by hand, so case and spacing are inconsistent.

columns.name: ENDDTE
columns.description: Date from which the client no longer holds the role, in YYYYMMDD format. 00000000 while the role is open.

columns.name: STRDTE
columns.description: Start date of the cross-reference record, in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: UNQADRIND
columns.description: Set when the client holds a correspondence address specific to this policy.

columns.name: CTBAMT
columns.description: Monthly premium amount in GBP paid by this client towards the policy. Held only on the paying role (the payer, else the policyholder); blank for roles that do not pay. 0.00 once premiums have stopped.

columns.name: BENPCT
columns.description: Percentage of the death benefit nominated to this beneficiary, 0-100 with two decimals. Held only on BN (Beneficiary) records; blank on every other role.

rules: Several records per policy: one per client per role, with history kept as ended records.
ENDDTE is 00000000 while STAXRF is 30 (Active) or 5 (Pending); it is set when STAXRF is 60 (Ended).
EM (Employer) roles appear only on GP-40 policies; AN (Annuitant) only on IR-05 policies.
SCHSUBCAT is populated only on EM records.

CTBAMT is populated on exactly one role per regular-premium policy: the PY record if present, otherwise the PH record. It is blank on all other roles and on IR-05 (single premium) policies, and 0.00 where the policy is no longer in force.
BENPCT is populated only on BN records; the BENPCT values of the active BN records of a policy add up to 100.
